name: Mismatched Socks
text: Whenever you throw off a card, gain +10 contract value for each card you've thrown off this round.
timing: When you throw off a card

signature.effect: contract value +10 per card you've thrown off this round

decision: When to throw off: each throw-off raises every later one, so the deck opens voids early, and on a void it chooses between throwing off for the growing payout and trumping for the trick.
opponent: Visible on each trigger, and the growing amount is public; opponents deny it by leading the suits the owner still holds.
aiNote: When void in the led suit, throw off rather than trump unless your team still needs the trick.
rationale: A discard deck throws off two to four cards a round, paying +30, +60, or +100 in total, about +50 a round late, which is rare-level contract value for Discard Dominance. Any suit counts, so every void feeds it, and the escalation rewards the relief enablers (Borrowed Umbrella, Wayward Cat, Tiptoe Sneaker) without paying per void (Scouring Tornado, DU-S12) or per club (Buried Bone, PU-C09).
deviation: Revision 1: replaced Paired Socks, which doubled the contract value other sigils paid on a club throw-off and so needed both club throw-offs and other discard payoffs before it did anything.
